settings.objective: CE + 0.3 causal token unlikelihood on unique past64 non-special tokens excluding the true next token; same raw targets

unlikelihood.normalization: sum negative penalties / valid target count

settings.initialization: Our Round11 latest model + AdamW moments + Torch/Python RNG; hold terminal learning rate
settings.schedule: Hold exact Round11 terminal LR throughout additional10000; preserve moments and RNG, no restart
settings.validationStatus: Previously exposed development sources; not independent unseen validation
settings.batching: Conditional length buckets64/128/256; same marginal row probabilities, correlated batch lengths; no target truncation. Different update trajectory from unbucketed pilots.

validation.metric: Weighted segmentation diagnostic; not probability of independent text
